constraints_details.constraints_layer_description: CILRES CIL ZONE: Lower Rate Eastern Zone - RATE: £40 per square metre
DMDAAP Designation: Area Action Plan- Area: North East Enfield- Policy: Core policy 40

description: Conversion of loft space into 1 bed self contained flat involving rear dormer and front rooflights.
decision_conditions: The proposed rear roof extension and front rooflights, by reason of their design, bulk, scale, visibility, disruption of the symmetry of the host building, and overdominance, would be detrimental to the street scene and cause harm to the character and appearance of the host building and surrounding area, contrary to Policies 7.4 and 7.6 of the London Plan (2016), Policy CP 31 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), and Policies DMD 13 and DMD 37 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).

The proposed development, by reason of its substandard gross internal area and bedroom floorspaces, would harm the quality of accommodation for future occupants, contrary to the DCLG Technical Housing Standards - Nationally Described Space Standard (2015), Policy 3.5 of the London Plan (2016), Policies CP 4 and CP 30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), and Policies DMD 8 and DMD 37 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).

The proposed development, by reason of its failure to demonstrate that the amenities of nearby properties would be preserved, would harm the quality of accommodation for neighbouring occupants, contrary to Policy 3.5 of the London Plan (2016), Policies CP 4 and CP 30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), and Policies DMD 5, DMD 8, DMD 9, and DMD 37 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).

The proposed development, by reason of its failure to demonstrate that private amenity spaces would be provided, would harm the quality of accommodation for future occupants, contrary to Policy 3.5 of the London Plan (2016), Policies CP 4 and CP 30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), and DMD 8, DMD 9, and DMD 37 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).
